# KpiGroup: a node in the value's place

- Files: `data-display/KpiGroup.tsx`
- Change: `KpiItem.display` (a node rendered in the value's place instead of
  the formatted number or the dash).
- Why: the open frame of Vicious Syndicate Gold (#656) shows a lock where a
  paid value stands, in the same tile and the same line as the value, so a
  guest's tile is as tall as a subscriber's.
- Upstream: not submitted; carry it over when the file is re-copied from the registry.
